capSemanticsReview.rationale: VaultV2 enter transfers the underlying USDT before creating the corresponding shares. Fee shares are accounting-mediated; neither curator nor allocator can arbitrarily mint unbacked shares or replace the immutable vault code. Allocation-cap increases change investment limits, not a native issuance ceiling. USDT issuer authority is inherited separately through the parent dependency.

controls.evidence: At block 26196563 this 2-of-3 Safe is owner, curator, allocator and sentinel. Owner can replace curator/sentinels; curator can appoint allocators without delay. The complete current Morpho API roster identifies this Safe and a separate allocator Safe; each membership is pinned through isAllocator/isSentinel. Full selector census: addAdapter/increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap=259200 seconds; removeAdapter/increaseTimelock/abdicate/setForceDeallocatePenalty=604800 seconds; allocator, send-assets-gate and fee/recipient settings=0. decreaseTimelock uses the target selector's delay, not its own zero entry. Share-transfer, receive-assets and adapter-registry setters are abdicated. Empty module pagination and zero guard are pinned. Every current adapter/collateral/market ID has uint128-max absolute cap and 100% relative cap, so the book has no effective diversification limit. Adapter burnShares and setSkimRecipient each have 259200-second delays. Force-deallocation penalty is 0.2%; both fee rates are zero. Signer independence and offchain custody remain undisclosed.

controls.evidence: At block 26196563 isAllocator=true and isSentinel=false. getThreshold=1 and getOwners returns the three recorded owners; module pagination is empty and guard storage is zero. This allocator can allocate/deallocate within admitted adapter and market caps, set the liquidity adapter/data and change maxRate without a timelock. It cannot raise allocation caps or arbitrarily mint shares. Liquidity-adapter changes can obstruct ordinary withdrawals; forceDeallocate remains a separate liquidity-dependent exit. Beneficial ownership, signer independence and offchain key custody are not established. Additional source research on 2026-10-20: Soter Labs' operator-published repository at revision 8e7fdea1bfed9be334fd0fcdb45244420056e907 identifies this exact allocator Safe and its already-enumerated owner 0xaf64ad999d65da1cecec2e694ce9caccc423d72a as the autonomous bot signer; the signing key is described as a sealed Railway environment variable. This establishes a disclosed software-signing workflow only, not HSM/MPC/hardware-wallet custody, recovery controls, beneficial-human independence or a new on-chain observation. Existing October 15 pins and review start are retained.

review.evidence: Pinned Ethereum block 26196563 (hash 0xa4d9465ae9769e038b6bc2afd7750401a68080edff6ca5e2a106838c97c80f1b; 2026-10-15T07:57:11Z): totalAssets=59582229.827675 USDT; totalSupply=58541705.825467484191603121 shares; convertToAssets(1e18)=1.017774 USDT; idle=0. Complete one-adapter/two-market census reconciles expected lender claims of 0.020572 and 59582229.807103 USDT exactly to realAssets and totalAssets. Both borrower markets use sUSDS at 96.5% LLTV; the vault's lender positions carry zero borrowing and collateral. The complete current indexed role roster, independently pinned membership and Safe reads identify a 2-of-3 owner/curator/allocator/sentinel Safe and a separate 1-of-3 allocator Safe. No wrapper-local arbitrary-recipient mint or proxy upgrade exists. Cap settings govern investment allocation, not unbacked issuance. Creation transaction 0x96ad4f7253a603dced0009beb518702260d31a4dc75dfa9216deaef6173b0a40 is re-read at block 24568955 (2026-03-02T09:46:23Z). Reconciliation=not-applicable describes local deposit-backed accounting, not parent reserve-to-total-liability financial assurance; supervision=none grants no prudential credit. Key custody and signer independence remain scoped questions for each Safe. This role census does not certify complete arbitrary-execution paths inside the controllers.
